title: Tailscale Rushes Patches After Uncoordinated Disclosure of ‘Tailworm’ Flaws
description: Tailscale SSH suffers from multiple privilege escalation vulnerabilities collectively called 'Tailworm,' disclosed publicly before patches were available. These flaws allow an attacker with access to a compromised device to escalate privileges on any server reachable via Tailscale SSH, potentially gaining root access and stealing keys to add rogue devices. The vulnerabilities enable wormable attacks that can propagate rapidly across servers without user interaction. Tailscale is preparing patches, with fixes already committed to public repositories but not yet released in a numbered version. Until patched, disabling SSH forwarding where not needed mitigates several serious issues.
